WITH transaction_counts AS (
  SELECT
    t.transreg,
    tr.tradekind,
    COUNT(*) OVER () AS overall_total
  FROM advancedbehavior AS a
  JOIN transactionrecord AS t
    ON t.transreg = a.translink
  JOIN trader AS tr
    ON tr.tradereg = t.trdref
),
type_counts AS (
  SELECT
    tradekind,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
    MAX(overall_total) AS overall_total
  FROM transaction_counts
  GROUP BY tradekind
)
SELECT
  tradekind,
  AVG(transaction_count) AS avg_count,
  AVG(CAST(transaction_count AS REAL) / overall_total) AS avg_share
FROM type_counts
GROUP BY tradekind
